question_text: Explain how transaction locking can prevent two clerks from overwriting each other’s edits to the same booking record.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A transaction obtains a suitable exclusive lock before updating the record. A competing writer waits or retries. The first change is committed before the next writer reads and updates the current value. Releasing locks at the appropriate transaction boundary preserves isolation and avoids a lost update.

marking_points.criterion: Update operates on current data in an ordered sequence.
